meta.name: agent-workflow-designer
meta.description: Design production-grade multi-agent workflows with clear pattern choice (sequential, parallel, hierarchical), handoff contracts, failure handling, and cost/context controls. Use when architecting a multi-step agent pipeline, choosing between single-agent vs multi-agent approaches, or refactoring an LLM workflow that suffers from context bloat or unreliable handoffs.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你设计多智能体工作流，包括选择流程模式、生成配置骨架、添加错误处理和成本控制。
howto.when: 当你需要构建多步骤的智能体流水线，或现有工作流出现上下文膨胀、交接不可靠时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个内容生成的多智能体工作流。
say.note: Claude 会引导你选择模式并生成配置骨架。

say.text: 为我的事故分类系统生成一个编排器工作流。
say.note: Claude 会调用脚本生成 JSON 配置文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you design multi-agent workflows, including selecting workflow patterns, generating skeleton configs, adding error handling, and cost/context controls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to build multi-step agent pipelines, or when existing workflows suffer from context bloat or unreliable handoffs.

say_en.text: Design a multi-agent workflow for content generation.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through pattern selection and config generation.

say_en.text: Generate an orchestrator workflow for my incident triage system.
say_en.note: Claude will run the scaffolder script to produce a JSON config.
